title: Fleet Capacity Advisor for Dedicated Pools: adaptive sizing & cost recommendations
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Build a Fleet Capacity Advisor feature that analyzes dedicated GPU pool telemetry and emits concrete sizing and policy recommendations to lower unit cost while preserving throughput SLOs. The advisor will: 1) ingest per-pool metrics (p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, queue lengths, model mix), 2) run both backward-looking utilization analysis and forward-looking simulations under configurable traffic scenarios, and 3) surface prioritized actions (scale-down candidate, instance-type swap, add pre-warming, change autoscale thresholds, pin model variants) with estimated monthly cost savings and risk level. The feature must respect throughput guarantees for committed capacity customers and integrate with existing autoscaling policies and rollout guardrails. Deliverables: backend pipeline (aggregation + simulation), scoring heuristics for recommendations, a simple API endpoint for Console/CLI to fetch recommendations, and an A/B pilot for a small set of customers. Security/PII: only aggregated telemetry will be used; no customer prompt data is accessed.
comments: 2025-01-15 - Amaya Chen: Initial PRD created. MVP scope limited to GPU pools in us-west-2 and us-east-1. Linked telemetry schema and raw metrics queries in PRD.

2025-01-20 - Ravi Patel: Tech spike completed. Confirmed that sample-level ingestion at 1m granularity is sufficient for simulations and reduces cost compared to 15s windows. Spike notes: https://confluence.internal/redwood/fleet-advisor-spike

2025-01-27 - Engineering sync: Decided to implement hybrid simulation approach: queuing model for short spikes + Monte Carlo for traffic volatility. Trade-off: more compute cost for simulations vs better recommendation quality.

2025-01-30 - Design review (Marta Lopez): Console panel wireframes reviewed. Requirement: recommendation card must include confidence score, estimated monthly savings, potential impact to p99 latency, and quick actions (create autoscale policy change PR, schedule maintenance window).
2025-02-03 - Security review request submitted by Ravi Patel: confirmed aggregated-only telemetry and KMS-protected storage. Ticket SEC-842 referenced in PRD.

2025-02-05 - QA notes (Jae Kim): End-to-end tests added for simulation correctness using synthetic traces. Edge case found: bursty traffic with <10 concurrent requests can produce noisy recommendations; added minimum sample window threshold.

2025-02-07 - Ravi Patel: Implemented first-pass recommendation engine and API endpoint. Integration tests passing for scale-down suggestions. Open follow-ups: cost model calibration against billing export and UX copy for risk levels. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3187
